name: Bulk Delete Alerts
description: Bulk Delete Alerts Bulk delete alerts for a given organization DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/
context:
DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/
Bulk delete alerts for a given organization
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: query (query) — An optional search query for filtering alerts.; id (query) — The ID of the alert you'd like to query.; project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`

name: Fetch Alerts
description: Fetch Alerts Returns a list of alerts for a given organization GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/
Returns a list of alerts for a given organization
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: sortBy (query) — The field to sort results by. If not specified, the results are sorted by id. Available fields are: - `name` - `id` - `dateCreated` - `dateUpdated` - `connectedDetectors` - `actions` - `priorityDetector` Prefix with `-` to sort in descending order.; query (query) — An optional search query for filtering alerts.; id (query) — The ID of the alert you'd like to query.; detector (query) — The IDs of monitors connected to the alerts you'd like to query.; project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`; per_page (query) — Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.; cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.
